packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink
packages.description: The Threadlink core: the subsystem runtime that deploys before the first scene, Iris events, content loading by generated ID through Addressables, Vault typed definitions, generated IDs, engineering settings, memory toolkits and the Editor Workspace with the Runtime monitor, Code Generation and Content pages.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.nexus
packages.description: Scene transitions that load and prepare the next scene before presenting it and keep the current scene on failure, for Build Profile and Addressables scenes.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.aura
packages.description: Audio cues with variations, categories, voice limits, fades and a crossfading music channel, with scene music as designer data.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.dextra
packages.description: Per-player input with saved rebinding and prompts, layered screens that block gameplay input while open, and interaction targeting.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.sentinel
packages.description: Accounts and platform capabilities routed to the installed provider, and per-account saves that are transactional, versioned and recoverable.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.sentinel.steam
packages.description: Steam accounts, achievements, statistics, leaderboards, presence, friends, invites, DLC, join intents and Steam Cloud, through Unity's Steamworks package or Steamworks.NET.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.deterministic
packages.description: Fixed-point numbers, vectors and rotations, and stateless seeded random streams that give identical results on every machine.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.starter
packages.description: A small complete game on Threadlink: menu and gameplay scenes, saves with recovery, settings with rebinding, audio and screens.

packages.name: com.threadforge.threadlink.showcase
packages.description: A gallery of runnable demos for every Threadlink feature, opened from the Threadlink Hub.
